mapper.select: SELECT a.uid, a.center_id, a.name, a.cert, a.last_updated, a.description, COALESCE(ag.agent_id, 0) AS agent_id, COALESCE(g.uid, 0) AS group_id, g.name as group_name FROM application a LEFT JOIN application_group ag ON a.uid = ag.application_id and a.center_id = ag.center_id LEFT JOIN `group` g ON ag.group_id = g.uid and ag.agent_id = g.agent_id WHERE a.center_id = #{centerId} and (ag.agent_id = #{agentId} OR ag.agent_id IS NULL)
